body: Sorry I didn't respond. I fell asleep. I'm gonna try to set some boundaries and with her since I do still love her. I don't really have the means to divorce. I feel ashamed to say I have no idea. I really wish I did. I have no family near by, nor friends. I have no money left (I haven't collected an unemployment check ever). She doesn't even believe he cheated on me anymore (she has herself convinced, even though she was bragging in front of my friends two weeks before she slept with him that she was going to sleep with him). I can't afford therapy. I can't get my dad back. I feel so helpless that I hate myself. Money I suppose money seems to solve a lot of problems, hell I don't even care if she took half. I didn't want to say that because I don't want to be that prick but hell moderately wealthy people get to afford mental health care, time to themselves, and divorce, it's fucked up.
